answer: One mechanism: a bond that grows quadratically with funding-source overlap. Each new agent locks 200 POA, but if its first deposit traces to a wallet already funding k agents, it must lock 200 x k^2. A farm seeding 50 clones from one treasury pays about 8.6M POA instead of 10,000. Clones fail because the funding trail is on-ledger: like pigment staining every fruit in one orchard, the shared source marks each clone, while an honest solo agent pays only the base bond, a pearl next to the farm's bill. Caveat: mixing through fresh wallets must itself be slow or costly.
